📋 12 Entry Points

Licensing

Marine Licensing — MCZ, EIA, In-Combination Effects

Marine licence applications under Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009. MCZ assessment — Conservation of Habitats Regs 2017. EIA screening for marine development. In-combination effect assessment. Licence conditions — mitigation, monitoring, compensation. Exemptions register. Post-consent compliance monitoring. Habitats Regulations Assessment. Appropriate assessment process.

Fisheries

Fisheries Management — Quota, IVMS, Landing Obligation

UK fisheries quota allocation post-Brexit — Fisheries Act 2020. IVMS — Inshore Vessel Monitoring for under-12m fleet. Discard ban / landing obligation enforcement. Catch documentation scheme. Fishing vessel licensing. Fisheries management plans (FMPs). Stock assessment evidence. MSY targets. Joint Fisheries Statement.

Planning

Marine Planning — Marine Plans, Sustainability Appraisal

English marine plans — Marine Policy Statement. Sustainability Appraisal (SA). Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA). Marine plan policies — development, conservation, infrastructure. Plan areas — East, South, North West, NE, SW. Interface with terrestrial LPA. Cumulative effects assessment. Marine plan review and monitoring. Socio-economic impact assessment.

MPA

Marine Protected Areas — MCZ, SAC, SPA, Monitoring

MCZs — designation and management. SACs — Annex I habitats. SPAs — seabird colonies. MPA monitoring — video, grab samples, divers. Conservation advice packages. MPA management measures — byelaws, voluntary. MPA network coherence. Good Environmental Status (GES) indicators. Feature condition assessment. Climate adaptation for MPAs.

Seabed

Seabed Mapping — Bathymetry, Habitat Survey, JNCC

Seabed habitat mapping — EUNIS classification. Bathymetric survey — LiDAR, multibeam, singlebeam. JNCC survey protocols. Seabed sediment classification. Biotope mapping. Sidescan sonar interpretation. Sub-bottom profiler data. Seabed habitat sensitivity mapping. UK SeaMAP. Seabed litter survey.

Vessel

Vessel Monitoring — AIS, VMS, IUU Fishing Detection

AIS — Automatic Identification System. VMS — Vessel Monitoring System for fleet over 12m. IUU fishing detection — illegal, unreported, unregulated. Vessel tracking analytics — speed, course, fishing pattern. Port state control. Transhipment monitoring. Vessel risk scoring. Dark fleet detection. Satellite AIS (S-AIS). Marine domain awareness.

Bycatch

Bycatch Mitigation — Pingers, BRUVs, Cetacean Monitoring

Acoustic deterrent devices (pingers) on gill nets. BRUV — Baited Remote Underwater Video monitoring. Cetacean bycatch reporting — harbour porpoise, common dolphin. Seabird bycatch mitigation — warp scarers, night setting. Marine mammal observer programmes. Bycatch limit thresholds (pBET). Remote Electronic Monitoring (REM). Net mesh modification. Seal depredation management.

Aquaculture

Aquaculture — Marine Fish Farm Licensing, Environmental Impact

Marine fish farm environmental licensing. Salmon farm siting — water quality, current flow. Effluent and waste management. Sea lice treatment — SLICE, H2O2. Escapee management and reporting. Wildlife interactions — seal, cetacean, seabird. Benthic impact monitoring. Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA). Crown Estate lease. Fish health and welfare.

Energy

Offshore Energy — Marine Licensing for Wind, Cables, Pipelines

Offshore wind farm marine licensing — Habitats Regs assessment. Subsea cable installation licensing. Pipeline consents. Scour protection and foundation impact. Decommissioning plans. Cumulative effects of multiple wind farms. Fisheries liaison officers. Navigation safety assessments. MMO consultation on NSIPs. Offshore transmission network.

Data

Data Governance — MMO Datasets, FOI, Marine Evidence

MMO data holdings — licensing, fisheries, vessel, MPA. Marine evidence base — MERMAN database. FOI compliance for marine data. Open data publication — data.gov.uk. UK Marine Strategy Part 1 indicators. Marine recorder species data. Geospatial marine data — GIS. Data sharing with JNCC, Cefas, EA. Marine noise registry.

Parliamentary

Parliamentary Evidence — Fisheries Stats, Marine Strategy

UK Sea Fisheries Statistics — annual publication. Fisheries quota uptake reporting. Marine licensing data for PQs. MPA condition assessment summaries. MSFD indicators. MMO annual report and accounts. EFRA Select Committee evidence. Marine enforcement statistics. International fisheries agreement monitoring. Post-Brexit fisheries performance.

Enforcement

Marine Enforcement — MMO Patrol, MCS, Prosecution

MMO marine enforcement — patrol vessels, aerial surveillance. Fisheries offence detection — VMS/AIS analysis. Marine licence breach investigation. Fixed penalty notices. Prosecution guidance — evidential and public interest test. Joint enforcement with Border Force, Royal Navy. Intelligence-led enforcement. REM compliance. International port state measures. IUU vessel listing.

⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Marine Licensing Automation

Automated marine licence screening and EIA pre-assessment. MCZ/HRA in-combination effect modelling. AI-assisted condition monitoring via satellite and AIS. Licence compliance scoring from remote sensing. Post-consent monitoring automation. Target: 50% reduction in processing time by 2028, automated screening for 80% of low-risk applications.

2. Fisheries Intelligence Platform

Real-time quota tracking and uptake forecasting. IVMS/AIS fusion for fishing effort analysis. Landing obligation compliance monitoring. FMP progress dashboards. IUU fishing pattern detection. Target: 95% quota uptake visibility within 24 hours, detect 90% of suspected discard violations via vessel analytics by 2027.

3. MPA Network Monitoring at Scale

Satellite-derived MPA condition monitoring — chlorophyll, turbidity. eDNA sampling for species verification. Automated BRUV video analysis via computer vision. MPA feature condition scoring. Climate vulnerability indexing. Target: Continuous monitoring for all 374 English MPAs, reducing manual survey cost by 60%, improving condition reporting to annual cycles.

4. Seabed Digital Twin

Integrated seabed habitat map combining bathymetry, sediment, biotope data. Real-time condition modelling from survey data. Seabed sensitivity mapping for licensing. Predictive habitat change modelling — climate, trawling, development. Target: Full digital twin of English seabed by 2029, integrating all MMO, JNCC, Cefas data into single geospatial platform.

5. Vessel Activity Analytics

AIS/VMS data fusion for complete marine domain awareness. AI vessel classification and behaviour anomaly detection. Dark fleet identification via S-AIS gaps. Automated IUU alerts. Port state control risk prioritisation. Target: Detect 95% of suspected IUU activity in UK waters within 1 hour, automated risk scoring for all foreign-flagged vessels entering UK EEZ.

6. Bycatch Prediction and Prevention

Real-time cetacean distribution modelling from eDNA, acoustic, visual data. Predictive bycatch risk maps — species, gear, area, season. Automated pinger effectiveness monitoring. BRUV video AI species ID. REM footage automated review. Target: Reduce cetacean bycatch in UK gillnet fisheries by 70% through predictive closures and automated pinger compliance by 2028.

7. Offshore Energy Evidence Synthesis

Automated cumulative effects assessment for offshore wind. Marine licensing evidence synthesis from MMO, JNCC, Cefas, EA. Fisheries impact modelling from VMS/IVMS. Habitat connectivity analysis. Decommissioning assessment. Target: Automated cumulative effects pre-assessment for all offshore wind applications, reducing consultation from 18 months to 6 months by 2029.

8. Parliamentary and Public Reporting

Automated UK Sea Fisheries Statistics production. Real-time MPA condition dashboard for EFRA Committee. Fisheries quota and FMP progress reporting. Marine licensing metrics. Enforcement statistics automation. Marine Strategy indicator updates. Target: Quarterly automated briefing packs on marine governance, real-time Parliamentary dashboard by 2027.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No marine licence issued without HRA compliance — every marine development must complete Habitats Regulations Assessment before consent, with appropriate assessment for any plan or project affecting MCZ/SAC/SPA
  • ❌ No fisheries quota decision made without stock evidence — all quota allocations and FMP measures must be underpinned by Cefas/ICES stock assessment data and MSY compliance targets
  • ❌ No MPA condition downgrade without verified multi-source evidence — MPA feature condition changes must be corroborated by survey, monitoring, and eDNA data before status revision
  • ❌ No vessel activity data shared without legal basis — AIS, VMS, and IVMS data must be processed under lawful basis (public task, legal obligation) and retained per MMO data retention policy
  • ❌ No bycatch risk assessment presented without species and gear specificity — all bycatch predictions must state target species, gear type, area, season, and confidence interval
  • ❌ No enforcement action taken without evidential threshold — prosecution or penalty must meet evidential test (realistic prospect of conviction) and public interest test per MMO prosecution guidance

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map MMO operational caseload — ~5,000 marine licence apps/yr, 374 MPAs, ~6,000 fishing vessels. Assess marine evidence landscape — MERMAN, Cefas, JNCC, UK SeaMAP. Profile enforcement volume — ~800 investigations/yr. Identify data integration opportunities across licensing, fisheries, MPA, seabed systems.
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers for MMO. Configure marine licensing automation, fisheries intelligence, MPA monitoring. Establish seabed digital twin data architecture. Design vessel analytics pipeline — AIS/VMS fusion, IUU detection.
3
Pilot: 90-day pilot across 3 marine plan areas and 2 fisheries offices. Measure licence processing time, MPA monitoring coverage, IUU detection rate. Collect caseworker, fisheries officer, MPA officer, enforcement officer feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all English marine plan areas. Integrate Cefas stock assessment, JNCC habitat data, EA water quality. Deploy vessel analytics for full UK EEZ coverage. Parliamentary reporting pipeline for EFRA Select Committee.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade marine governance reporting. MPA condition dashboards. Fisheries compliance metrics. Marine licensing performance analytics. Enforcement outcome tracking. Marine Strategy indicator automation.
